name: iso-42001-aims-implementation-suite
known_facts: ISO 42001:2023 is the AI Management System (AIMS) standard
High-risk AI classification per EU AI Act requires additional impact assessments
Model cards document AI system purpose, performance, limitations, and biases
AI risk categories include bias, accuracy, robustness, transparency, privacy, accountability, environmental
Third-party AI systems (API-based LLMs) are in scope of AIMS
Data drift and concept drift require continuous monitoring
Human oversight must be meaningful -- not just rubber-stamping

input.ai_system_purpose: Automated credit underwriting for retail lending
